name: context-rail
description: Context rail: moves file-specific decisions out of always-loaded CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md into PRECEDENT.md records beside the code, and installs an arrival hook that injects a file's recorded decisions — with a confirm-before-changing paragraph — when an agent reads or edits it. Resident instructions only shrink.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver recorded decisions when a file is opened
interface.longDescription: Context rail: moves file-specific decisions out of always-loaded CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md into PRECEDENT.md records beside the code, and installs an arrival hook that injects a file's recorded decisions — with a confirm-before-changing paragraph — when an agent reads or edits it. Resident instructions only shrink.
defaultPrompt: Use context-rail to set up decision records for this project.
